never: create a job; a close starts from the job id the job system issued
invent a part, or a price the business's own price book does not hold
price a variation the quote did not cover
write a card the assigned tech has not confirmed
mark a job complete before the write returns the job system's ids
write a second card for one capture, or mint a new intent id on a retry
stays_with_person: confirming the draft: the assigned tech, from their own phone
pricing every part parked as not in the book or ambiguous
pricing every variation, and getting the customer's signature for it
chasing a tech who has not confirmed, as their supervisor

provider_block.job: the job card done on site

with_us.note: Office Voice's close_job writes the confirmed card into ServiceM8 once per intent id: the note, the job materials priced from ServiceM8's own catalogue, the photos, then Completed only when every part came back with an id. Lines with no catalogue code are parked on the Exception Desk. A tech can also close by text or picture message to the business's Office Voice number and reply YES. In Simpro it writes the note and the stage today; parts and photos park on the Exception Desk for a person to add. A ServiceM8 connection made before 2 November 2026 is reconnected once to allow materials and attachments.

checks.title: The job exists and this tech is on it
What the tech said is stored before anything is taken from it
Every part is a price book line or it is parked
A variation is never priced at close
The tech confirms the draft before it is written
A draft nobody confirms goes to the tech's supervisor
One write, with the job system's ids back
The job is marked complete only after the write returns ids
Every parked item goes to the exceptions queue with an owner
The close is on the record, by job
